faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1_answer: AllDocs uses on-device text recognition (OCR) to scan and make documents searchable. Images and recognized text never leave your phone during this process.
faq.q2_question: Are my documents stored in the cloud?
faq.q2_answer: For now, your documents are stored only on your device. Cross-device sync is being built and will follow the same principle: content is always encrypted before it leaves your phone.
faq.q3_answer: AllID is the account shared between AllDocs and AllPhotos. You use the same email and password (or the same Google sign-in) in both apps, and a paid subscription unlocks premium features in both.
faq.q4_answer: The free plan includes document organization and scanning. A paid plan unlocks extra features across both All apps — subscription management is coming soon.
faq.q5_answer: When AllDocs detects a validity date on a document (like an ID card or an insurance policy), it can schedule a local reminder before that date expires.
faq.q6_question: What do the PIN and biometrics protect?
faq.q6_answer: The PIN/biometrics lock access to the app on your device. It's independent from your AllID account password — losing one doesn't affect the other.
faq.q7_question: How do I export or remove my documents?
faq.q7_answer: You can export all your documents to a folder of your choice from Settings > Export documents. To remove a specific document, long-press it in the archive.
